Message.Name: Options Quote Message
Message.Description: An Options quote message is sent when any event results in a new top of book value on either side of the market.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The series sequence number.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: The Ask price. Use the Price scale from the Series Index message.

Field.Name: Ask Volume
Field.Description: Total quantity available at the above Ask price

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: The Bid price. Use the Price scale from the Series Index message.

Field.Name: Bid Volume
Field.Description: Total quantity available at the above Bid price.

Field.Name: Quote Condition
Field.Description: Quote Condition

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: AskCustomerVolume
Field.Description: Total quantity of customer orders at the Ask price

Field.Name: BidCustomerVolume
Field.Description: Total quantity of customer orders at the Bid price

Message.Name: Options Trade Message
Message.Description: An Options Trade message is sent when there is an execution on the order book.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The series sequence number.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for this trade.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the Trade. Use the Price scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The volume of the trade in contracts.

Field.Name: TradeCond1
Field.Description: Settlement related conditions.

Field.Name: TradeCond2
Field.Description: Trade through exemption conditions.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: TradeCond4
Field.Description: Additional trade conditions.

Message.Name: Options Trade Cancel Message
Message.Description: In the event that an earlier trade has been reported in error, an Options Trade Cancel message is sent.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The series sequence number.

Field.Name: OriginalTradeID
Field.Description: The original TradeID of the Trade being cancelled.

Message.Name: Options Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: In the event that an earlier trade has been reported with one or multiple fields in error, an Options Trade Correction message is sent.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The series sequence number.

Field.Name: OriginalTradeID
Field.Description: The original TradeID of the Trade message being corrected.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: The TradeID of the corrected Trade message.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The corrected price of the Trade. Use the Price scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The corrected volume of the trade in contracts.

Field.Name: TradeCond1
Field.Description: Settlement related conditions.

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Reserved 2
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Reserved 3
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Options Imbalance Message
Message.Description: Options Imbalance messages are published every 5 seconds during opening and reopening auctions to update price and volume information.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: PairedQty
Field.Description: The number of contracts paired off at the Indicative Match Price.

Field.Name: TotalImbalanceQty
Field.Description: The total imbalance quantity at the Indicative Match Price.

Field.Name: MarketImbalanceQty
Field.Description: The total market order imbalance quantity at the Indicative Match Price.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: Auction type indicator

Field.Name: ImbalanceSide
Field.Description: The side of the TotalImbalanceQty

Field.Name: ContinuousBookClearingPrice
Field.Description: The price at which all interest on the book can trade, including auction and imbalance offset interest, and disregarding auction collars.

Field.Name: AuctionInterestClearingPrice
Field.Description: The price at which all eligible auction-only interest would trade, subject to auction collars.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: IndicativeMatchPrice
Field.Description: The price at which the highest number of contracts would trade, subject to auction collars. It includes the non-displayed quantity of Reserve Orders.

Field.Name: Upper Collar
Field.Description: Legal width bid for option

Field.Name: Lower Collar
Field.Description: Legal width offer for option

Field.Name: Auction Status
Field.Description: Indicates whether the auction will run

Message.Name: Series RFQ Message
Message.Description: The Request for Series RFQ message is published for outright series. It is generated by the matching engine to solicit interest in an auction or order.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this series

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the RFQ

Field.Name: Type
Field.Description: Order Type of CUBE/BOLD/COA

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: Customer or Firm capacity specified with the order. This field is only used for BOLD (Type = B).

Field.Name: Total quantity
Field.Description: Total quantity

Field.Name: Working Price
Field.Description: RFQ Price

Field.Name: Participant
Field.Description: OCC Number for the Clearing firm specified with the order. 0 when no OCC Number was specified. This field is only used for BOLD (Type = B).

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: Auction ID for CUBE/COA

Field.Name: RFQ Status
Field.Description: This status field is used for CUBE/COA (Type = C).

Message.Name: Outright Series Summary Message
Message.Description: The outright series summary message is sent every 60 seconds, on a separate multicast channel from the main feed.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset (UTC Time) from the Time Reference message.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: HighPrice
Field.Description: The Highest price of the series for the day. Use the Price scale from the series mapping index.

Field.Name: LowPrice
Field.Description: The Lowest price of the series for the day. Use the Price scale from the series mapping index.

Field.Name: Open
Field.Description: The First price of the series for the day. Use the Price scale from the series mapping index.

Field.Name: Close
Field.Description: The Last price of the series for the day. Use the Price scale from the series index mapping.

Field.Name: TotalVolume
Field.Description: The cumulative volume for the outright series throughout the day.
